tool.name: 3Dtrees: CSP StandSegmentation
tool.description: DTM generation and multi-segmentation forest inventory with optional comparative shortest path segmentation
tool.command: mkdir -p output_dir && cp '$input' input.laz && Rscript /opt/CspStandSegmentation/exec/run.R --input 'input.laz' --output-dir output_dir --non-tree-ids '$non_tree_ids' --dtm-resolution '$dtm_resolution' --random-seed '$random_seed' #if $aoi_json: --aoi-json '$aoi_json' #end if #for $segmentation in $segmentations: #if $segmentation.species.mode == 'provided': --segmentation-spec '${segmentation.instance_dimension},${segmentation.species.species_dimension},${segmentation.species.species_probability_dimension}' #else: --segmentation-spec '${segmentation.instance_dimension}' #end if #end for --enable-csp '$csp.enable' #if $csp.enable == 'true': --seed-mode '$csp.seeds.mode' #if $csp.seeds.mode == 'supplied': --seed-file '$csp.seeds.seed_file' #end if #if $csp.seed_tuning.mode == 'fine_tune': --seed-resolution '$csp.seed_tuning.seed_resolution' --seed-z-min '$csp.seed_tuning.seed_z_min' --seed-z-max '$csp.seed_tuning.seed_z_max' --seed-quantile '$csp.seed_tuning.seed_quantile' --seed-eps '$csp.seed_tuning.seed_eps' #end if #if $csp.routing_tuning.mode == 'fine_tune': --routing-workers '$csp.routing_tuning.routing_workers' --voxel-resolution '$csp.routing_tuning.voxel_resolution' --verticality-weight '$csp.routing_tuning.verticality_weight' --linearity-weight '$csp.routing_tuning.linearity_weight' --sphericity-weight '$csp.routing_tuning.sphericity_weight' #end if #end if #if $geometry_tuning.mode == 'fine_tune': --geometry-threads '$geometry_tuning.geometry_threads' --geometry-k '$geometry_tuning.geometry_k' #end if #if $memory_tuning.mode == 'fine_tune': --read-chunk-size '$memory_tuning.read_chunk_size' --chunk-buffer '$memory_tuning.chunk_buffer' --dtm-workers '$memory_tuning.dtm_workers' --dtm-strategy '$memory_tuning.dtm_strategy' --dtm-candidate-resolution '$memory_tuning.dtm_candidate_resolution' --dtm-streaming-threshold '$memory_tuning.dtm_streaming_threshold' --inventory-partitions '$memory_tuning.inventory_partitions' #end if #if $inventory_tuning.mode == 'fine_tune': --slice-min '$inventory_tuning.slice_min' --slice-max '$inventory_tuning.slice_max' --slice-increment '$inventory_tuning.slice_increment' --slice-width '$inventory_tuning.slice_width' --max-dbh '$inventory_tuning.max_dbh' #end if

param.name: input
param.label: Merged point cloud
param.help: LAS/LAZ point cloud in a projected CRS. Existing segmentation dimensions are selected below.

param.name: instance_dimension
param.label: Instance attribute
param.help: Exact LAS dimension, for example PredInstance_SAT or PredInstance_FM.

validator.message: Use a LAS dimension containing only letters, digits, and underscores.

param.name: species_dimension
param.label: Species attribute
param.help: Species ID dimension corresponding to this instance segmentation.

validator.message: Use a LAS dimension containing only letters, digits, and underscores.

param.name: species_probability_dimension
param.label: Species probability attribute
param.help: Probability dimension corresponding to the selected species attribute.

validator.message: Use a LAS dimension containing only letters, digits, and underscores.

param.name: non_tree_ids
param.label: Non-tree instance IDs
param.help: Comma-separated IDs excluded from every inventory.

validator.message: Provide comma-separated integer or decimal IDs.

param.name: seed_file
param.label: CSP seed table
param.help: Tab-separated table with numeric X, Y, Z, and unique positive TreeID columns.

param.name: aoi_json
param.label: Area of interest (optional)
param.help: GeoJSON Polygon, MultiPolygon, Feature, or FeatureCollection. Coordinates must describe the input point-cloud area.

param.name: geometry_threads
param.label: Geometry and point-cloud threads
param.help: Caps lidR DTM/normalization work and upstream geometry calculations. Default: 1.

param.name: read_chunk_size
param.label: Spatial tile size (m)
param.help: Core tile size for DTM processing and inventory-only spatial reads. Default: 300 m.

param.name: chunk_buffer
param.label: DTM chunk buffer (m)
param.help: Overlap used for chunk-local ground classification and terrain interpolation.

param.name: dtm_workers
param.label: Parallel DTM workers
param.help: Concurrent readers or spatial DTM tiles. Each spatial worker uses one lidR thread to avoid nested CPU oversubscription.

param.name: dtm_strategy
param.label: DTM read strategy
param.help: Automatic uses spatial reads for smaller inputs and memory-bounded point-range streaming for large inputs.

param.name: dtm_candidate_resolution
param.label: Streaming candidate resolution (m)
param.help: Keeps the minimum Z at the deterministic cell centre before CSF/TIN. Must not exceed the DTM resolution; smaller values use more memory.

param.name: dtm_streaming_threshold
param.label: Automatic streaming threshold (points)
param.help: Automatic mode switches to streaming at this total input point count.

param.name: inventory_partitions
param.label: Disk-backed instance partitions
param.help: Instances are grouped by ID on disk so each tree remains complete without retaining the full cloud in memory.

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool always creates a digital terrain model and calculates one forest inventory for every selected instance dimension. It can optionally run the upstream Comparative Shortest Path algorithm and add `PredInstance_CSP`.
**Species attributes**
Species ID and probability attributes are optional and are configured independently for each segmentation. They must be provided as a pair. If no segmentation has species attributes, species columns and the species-composition output are omitted. If only some segmentations have species attributes, their individual inventories include species fields and the combined inventory leaves those fields empty for other segmentations.
**ForestMamba attributes**
For `PredInstance_FM`, the tool reports median valid `PredScore_FM`, whether multiple valid scores occur within an instance, and wood/leaf point counts and shares from `PredSemantic_FM`. Ground is excluded from the wood/leaf denominator.
**Ground and DTM**
Valid `Classification=2` points are reused. Otherwise, ground is classified with CSF. The original classifications are not overwritten in the optional CSP point-cloud output. The default DTM resolution is 0.2 m. Inputs below 50 million points use spatial DTM reads; larger inputs first stream a deterministic 0.1 m minimum-Z candidate surface and then run CSF/TIN in 300 m tiles with a 5 m buffer. Up to 10 DTM workers are used by default. Unsupported edge areas remain NoData while the raster retains the aligned point-cloud extent.
**Outputs**
- Full DTM and, when an AOI is supplied, an AOI-clipped DTM - Combined and per-segmentation inventories, each including point count - Stand statistics and optional species composition - Effective CSP seeds and a point cloud with `PredInstance_CSP` only when CSP is enabled - Run metadata and lightweight resource measurements
The input must use a projected coordinate reference system with horizontal and vertical units in metres. Missing requested attributes, failed segmentation calculations, or failed inventory processing cause the complete job to fail.
